title: Occurrence change intensity
description: Change in water occurrence between 1984-1999 and 2000-2024, from homologous months. 100 is no change. From the [GSW v1.5 Data Users Guide](https://storage.googleapis.com/water-world/downloads_ancillary/DataUsersGuidev2024_v.5.pdf): "Change in water occurrence intensity between two epochs (16 March 1984 to 31 December 1999, and 1 January 2000 to 31 December 2024) was also produced. This is derived from homologous pairs of months (that is, the same months contain valid observations in both epochs). [...] Areas where there are no pairs of homologue months could not be mapped." The collection holds the 504 upstream 10° × 10° tiles as items, copied byte for byte (0.00025° grid, EPSG:4326, uint8, nodata 255), and one global overview COG at 0.004° for display. Read [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md) for access patterns.
